evidence: FB2-SAF-FSR-000004's rationale reads: 'addresses timing budget violation in main path (115 ms > 100 ms FTTI) by providing parallel safety channel'. FB2-HW-TSR-000004 repeats the same sentence word for word. No record in the corpus contains 115 ms. The nearest figure is FB2-SAF-SGO-000001's allocation, whose serial elements sum to 85 ms for the main path. 115 is neither 85 (the actual sum) nor 105 (the sum plus the recorded margin), so it cannot be reconstructed from the corpus at all.
impact: The justification for adding an independent ASIL B hardware channel - a substantial hardware cost and the basis of the ASIL D decomposition - rests on a number that cannot be located or reproduced. A reader checking the arithmetic finds nothing to check, and the most likely reading is that the figure was estimated at some point and never reconciled. The independent monitor may well be justified; the justification as written does not support it.
root_cause: The figure appears to predate the current allocation and to have survived a later rewrite of the timing budget without being updated. Two records carrying the identical sentence mean the figure has been copied rather than checked twice, so a single unverified number propagated to both the functional and the hardware level.
resolution:
RESOLVED, and the vocabulary member is corrected from 'accepted' to 'resolved'. Re-verified on 2026-09-30T00:00:00Z over the LIVE fields of FB2-SAF-FSR-000004, FB2-HW-TSR-000004 and both assumption registries: the 115 ms figure appears in zero live justification fields. It survives only in revision_history entries and in the safety concepts' `contradiction` blocks, which quote it precisely in order to record its removal, and in the superseded as_is vertical-slice review record FB2-REV-000001, which is where this finding established that it came from.

This record's own correction of its own evidence is the part worth keeping: it originally reported 115 ms as appearing in no record and therefore not reconstructible. It is reconstructible - 100 + 10 + 5 from a superseded allocation - so the figure was STALE rather than fabricated, and the remedy changed from reconstructing it to deleting it. That is a more precise root cause and a cheaper fix, and it is recorded here rather than quietly overwritten. The justification now rests on figures that still hold: the main path is 85 ms of the 100 ms interval, 95 ms at the 40 ms upper tolerance of FB2-PRM-000005, and 110 ms if detection waits one full acquisition period of FB2-PRM-000003. human_approval_status remains pending, production_authorized remains false and product_verification_credit remains false.
